item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 11:00 AM 18 August 2026

Red Warning: #OrientalMindoro
Associated Hazard: Severe FLOODING in flood prone areas. Higher chances of LANDSLIDES over the landslide prone areas

Meanwhile, Moderate to heavy rains are expected over #Sorsogon(Casiguran, Gubat, Bulan, Matnog, SantaMagdalena, Irosin, Bulusan, Barcelona, Magallanes, Juban), #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando, Batuan, Aroroy, Mandaon, Balud, Milagros, Baleno, CityOfMasbate, Mobo, Uson), #Catanduanes(Pandan, Caramoran), #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Libmanan, Lupi, Pamplona, Pasacao, Ragay, Sipocot), #CamarinesNorte(JosePanganiban, Paracale, Basud, Mercedes, SanLorenzoRuiz, SanVicente, Talisay, Daet, Vinzons), #NorthernSamar(SanVicente, Capul and SanAntonio) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar, CityOfSorsogon, Castilla, PrietoDiaz), #Masbate(SanPascual, Claveria), #Catanduanes(Bagamanoc, Viga, Gigmoto, Baras, Bato, SanMiguel, SanAndres, Panganiban, Virac), #Marinduque, #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, Labo), #Albay, #CamarinesSur(Baao, Balatan, Bato, Bombon, Buhi, Bula, Cabusao, Calabanga, Camaligan, Canaman, Caramoan, Gainza, Garchitorena, Goa, IrigaCity, Lagonoy, Magarao, Milaor, Minalabac, Nabua, NagaCity, Ocampo, Pili, Presentacion, Sagñay, SanFernando, SanJose, Siruma, Tigaon, Tinambac) and #Romblon which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 02:00 PM Today.
